title: Columbus HIN map feature recovery
text: The catalogued Columbus High Injury Network webmap references HIN_PROPOSED3_gdb FeatureServer layer 0. Its November 14, 2026 snapshot contains 509 line features, reconciled against the service count and unique OBJECTID values. Street names and geometries are available in data/local_hin/network.geojson. These are network features, not 509 crashes. Crash attribute periods and weighting are not established in this recovery, so their sums must not be compared with the 2021–2025 ODOT snapshot. The webmap layer is not independently established as the newest policy version.
caveats: This is the layer referenced by the catalogued webmap, not a claim that it is the newest HIN policy version.
The period/weighting of crash-derived attributes is not established here. Do not present their sums as 2021–2025 crash counts.
